notes.title: GREAT UPDATE
notes.content:
Well, many years later, there was a programmer who was able to fix the game. 

Previously non-working achievements have been fixed, the engine version has been updated (perhaps this is related, I'm not sure).

And now there is a free mobile version of the game available in Russian.
https://www.rustore.ru/catalog/app/ru.total.caramba

tags.bug: Previously non-working achievements have been fixed

tags.feature: And now there is a free mobile version of the game available in Russian.
